title: fastDecision 4.0 Released
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
New Name

  • decisionAccelerator is now called fastDecision. The new version number is 4.0.

decisionAccelerator is now called fastDecision. The new version number is 4.0.

Licensing

  • New licensing scheme introduced based on a License Key. The License Key is valid even if the user replaces their machine, and should therefore be kept in a safe place. More here: https://lateralworks.com/tools/2020/3/23/activating-fastdecision
